findings.detail: Old plans did not name scored suites, adapter contracts, matched controls, per-stratum decisions or retained-answer evidence. Added those to both owned pages.
Kimi SGLang DSpark profile changes DCP8 and ReplaySSM alongside speculation; new plan requires supported target-only DCP control before attributing speedup to DSpark.
DeepSeek four-versus-eight GPU scaling is separated from equal-eight-GPU one-group versus two-group comparison; aggregate admission and routing held fixed first.

Exact NVIDIA DeepSeek 0731 NVFP4 derivative exists at f1caa71142bd0be02f728c79f75042ac1e461579 and is named in current SGLang docs. Card states DSpark was not exercised in derivative validation. Added unqualified follow-up only; no catalog/profile/model facts changed.

64K input plus output does not fit 65,536-token launch cap; high/max DeepSeek 384K output recommendation requires separately qualified long-budget arm; Kimi short caps can finish before a final answer.

limitations: Metadata and documentation retrieval only; no weights, engine installation, GPU run or benchmark execution.
